name: chain chausses
_design_note: F20-70 medium legs slot. Mail leg covering, traditionally paired with hauberk. Covers chain_leggings, iron_leggings, scale_greaves from legacy data.
lore_template: A pair of {material_name} chausses, mail leggings hung from the belt and gathered at the ankle. Knights wore them under a hauberk so the rings ran unbroken from collarbone to shin. They allow a full stride and turn most cuts.
